name: product-reality-reviewer
description: Review plans, built web and native apps, and marketing sites from the customer's starting knowledge, task and buying decision. Find missing journeys for first-time, returning and power users, builder-only assumptions, engineering details that displace buyer value, and unsupported sales promises. Use when asked what is missing, how customers will use this, or whether a page helps sell the product. NOT for code correctness, pure visual polish, prose style alone, or measured conversion claims without behavioral evidence.
